name: Kelvin Leong
text: There's always that apprehension when it comes to a renovation project. From design alignment to communications and actual physical works, there will always be this worry that things might go awry. However, working with Eileen and Jason kept that to a minimum and throughout the entire process, one key word stands out: Trust. We trusted them to understand our design concerns and they delivered flawlessly. They took our concerns about meshing functionality and aesthetics seriously and modelled a home that is both aesthetically-pleasing and ultra functional. The balance is uncanny and we are very impressed by their attention to detail. We trusted them to tell us the negatives. Be it a last minute change, something that went unexpectly wrong or even when our wants were just not feasible. We wanted to be in the know and they were very liberal with sharing their knowledge and expertise. They were candid with their sharing and that mades the entire process very enjoyable. We definitely love them being not yes-(wo)men and their effort to explain their point. That was really something that we are particularly thankful for. We trusted them to see things through. This was especially important when they shared any negatives because then, we all would need to come up with a solution. And they were relentless problem solvers. They thought through every problem and tried to come up with the best answer. Even if there were compromises to be made, they were honest and upfront about it and would continue to find ways to make the compromise a non-concern at the end of the day. The amount of fervour and commitment were just so pure that it wiped our apprehension away. So overall, we woud like to say a big thank you to Jason and Eileen. The trust were there throughout then entire process. You two made our dream home come true and we would love to see your future projects.

name: Sherie Chew
text: I had my home renovation done with Voila a few years back, and I really like the entire design. Even now, if I need any small fixes or changes, I always call Jason. He's super quick to get back to me and fix things. He's always giving me good advice and making sure everything gets sorted out without any hassle.

name: Regina Lim
text: Excellent service! Excellent work! Eileen did a fantastic job for my 2rm BTO! She understands and knows exactly what I want and produced a cozy home for me which I envisioned. name: NX
text: I reached out to 5 ID firms and eventually chose Ming Yi to be our ID for our 2 bed + 1 study apartment. She has a flair in design and we immediately fell in love with her first render draft (minimal changes were required before carpentry fabrication). She is also super detailed to ensure all workmanship is of quality and handled the timeline of the renovation swiftly. Post Reno, Ming Yi was very efficient in arranging to fix any defects too. I’ve heard so many reno horror stories and I’m glad ours went along so smoothly! Thank you Ming Yi for building our beautiful home ❤️

We would definitely recommend her to anyone out there looking to transform their houses into a place where they can call it a home 👍🏼

name: Gindelin Low
text: In a sea of ID horror stories, very thankful that we had a superb experience with our ID Kok Wei from Voila. Our 4-room BTO renovation was extensive (includes reconfiguration of the rooms, hacking and re-tiling) and the project was under time pressure because of delays for our key collection, but Kok Wei managed to work his magic and delivered our home to us on time :)Throughout the process, he showed up with creativity and was very accommodating, going above and beyond what an ID should do, including taking calls with us at 11pm because of our work schedules, coordinating with our vendors, and being game to explore new ideas (eg we wanted dog doors and skylights). In the many decisions we had to make, he provides detailed counsel, laying out the pros and cons of each option and his final recommendation, which we appreciate given that we are first time homeowners. While we hear from our friends stories of having to head down and check on their renovation progress every other day because they do not trust their ID, we honestly only visited 6-8 times throughout the 2.5 months. Not a recommendation or benchmark - but just an indication of how much of a breeze the entire experience was. A key element we valued was how much we trusted Kok Wei, and that contributed to this positive experience. When there were issues (as with any renovation project), he tries his best to rectify as soon as possible or providing alternatives solutions. We even saw him making some paint touch ups on a Sunday just to make sure we get our place in the best possible condition before the handover! Grateful that we had such a great partner throughout this renovation experience. Highly recommend (we have been recommending to our friends) and thank you for designing our first home! 😊

name: Xiu Han Chen
text: Everything is good, and we’re really happy to have chosen Helen as our ID! She has been great to work with throughout the entire process and is always super responsive, big claps to her! Helen takes the time to truly understand what we want from the very beginning, and she does so with professionalism, enthusiasm, and genuine care. She’s able to convey ideas precisely, and her designs always strike a great balance between aesthetics and practicality. Her sense of style is spot on, and she consistently manages to bring everything together beautifully. We also really appreciate her efficiency in planning all the works. The renovation was completed earlier than expected and turned out even better than we imagined. The entire renovation process was completely fuss-free, and Helen made everything smooth and enjoyable from start to finish. Thanks, Helen, you’re truly the one to work with! :)

name: Lace Zhang
text: Transformed my home and helped build my dream home, thanks to Jason & Eileen. :) love the island design Jason thought of to maximize space for my kitchen area, so everything fits nicely for my needs, and how cozy everything looks.

name: Joanne Lim
text: My husband and I recently engaged Jason and Eileen from Voila to renovate our new home, and we couldn’t be more pleased and thankful for their valuable ideas, polished workmanship, and responsiveness. We only had two months to plan and six weeks to renovate, and somehow, they made magic happen! VOILA! Before selecting an ID firm, we shared our brief with three companies and met with each designer in person. What made Voila stand out was how practical and thoughtful their approach was. While the other firms simply presented proposals based strictly on what I requested with no space management advice, Jason took the time to understand our actual needs and gave us honest, professional advice on how to make the most of our space. He offered creative and functional suggestions, identified blind spots that other IDs completely missed, and was not afraid to challenge our initial ideas when he saw a better, more practical solution. That was when we knew Voila was the right choice. One thing we especially appreciated about Jason was how he consistently had our best interests in mind, whether it was saving money or reducing unnecessary work. Our home is a brand new condo with limited kitchen space. Rather than proposing to hack the kitchen, which would’ve cost more and voided our warranty, he cleverly suggested relocating the washer to the storage room, which he then transformed into a beautiful and functional laundry/storage space. He even reused our existing kitchen cabinet door originally for the washer to repurposed them into drawers, which we thought was such a smart and cost saving touch. Throughout the renovation, Jason and Eileen were incredibly hands-on and always responsive. They typically replied to messages within the hour, even late at night, and Eileen went the extra mile by scheduling online meetings with us after 10pm to accommodate our availability. Thanks to Jason’s proactive planning, including early application for renovation permits, everything stayed on track and moved smoothly. We are extremely happy with the finished result and overall workmanship. Jason even spotted minor defects and resolved them before we had a chance to notice. It was clear that they both take a lot of pride in their work and genuinely care about client satisfaction. Our overall experience with Jason and Eileen was smooth, stress-free, and truly enjoyable. If you’re looking for an ID team that combines creativity, professionalism, integrity, and care, we would highly recommend Voila!

name: Wee Hin Lee
text: I had the pleasure of working with Helen How, and I cannot recommend her highly enough. From the very beginning, design conceptualisation, all the way through to project management and completion, Helen demonstrated exceptional professionalism, creativity, and care. She was incredibly meticulous and thoughtful, taking the time to deeply understand my preferences and lifestyle needs. What truly stood out was her ability to align perfectly with my vision, she just knew what I wanted, often anticipating my needs before I even articulated them. Throughout the project, Helen remained patient and solution-oriented, always weighing the pros and cons of different decisions without rushing anything. Her recommendations were always grounded, practical, and aesthetically on point. Despite a tight and rushed timeline, she managed to deliver everything on schedule, without compromising on quality. Her communication was excellent, I appreciated the frequent updates, which kept me informed and reassured throughout. Helen is a rare combination of creative talent and precision, and her ability to translate ideas into thoughtful, well-executed spaces is outstanding. If you’re looking for someone who listens, understands, and delivers, Helen is the one to work with.

name: Chua Cheng Liang
text: After meeting with many other IDs, we engaged Jason as our ID in Mar 2020 as he was able to understand and further conceptualise our requirement for a modern contemporary home that was both warm and welcoming. Jason was patient throughout the many times that we met with him to discuss further on our theme and design even before signing the contract. When we went through the contract, he was honest and upfront about what was really needed and good-to-have, which enabled us to better keep to our budget. Just when we were about to start renovations, phase 1 of COVID-19 was announced and we had no choice but to postpone our renovations until mid-Aug 2020. During this time, Jason kept us updated on industry developments, including manpower constraints and shortage of imported supplies, which we appreciated. Even after we started renovations, Jason continued to keep us updated and also had his better contractors work on our house, which gave us better assurance. We can honestly say that the renovation process was largely snooth due to Jason's problem-solving attitude and making sure that any mistakes made by his contractors were quickly rectified or re-done at no additional costs to us. At a time when phase 2 of COVID-19 gave us much anxieties as to when renovations could finally be completed, Jason managed to deliver a house that we now love so much by early Dec 2020. This was despite manpower shortage that he had to manage and after minor touch-ups here and there. Post-renovation, Jason would immediately offer to dispatch his guys to our house without us asking if we thought that something was not working well. He would even "chase" us repeatedly for a reply on when his guy could come down when we took some time to get back to him. We felt that Jason really put in his all when he worked on our house. Jason has proven himself to be responsive, reliable, and someone with integrity. We couldn't recommend him more as an ID. He is an ID-turned-friend, and definitely no regrets with engaging him as our ID!

name: Junwei Loh
text: I'm beyond happy and satisfied to have worked with Mingyi at Voila Design to bring the vision to reality. From conceptualization during the moodboard stagesto the rendering and material selection, Mingyi was very thoughtful, meticulous and kept to the timelines as much as possible (barring some minor hiccups that every homeowner should expect with renovations in general). I knew the decision was right with choosing Mingyi when she fully understood the brief and delivered a beautifully designed home that took into consideration the quirks and compactness of a small condo apartment. She was also very much involved in helping with the choice of furniture and light fittings to make the space and design very cohesively put together. I was also updated throughout the whole renovation process. Feedback and changes were well accommodated and followed up in a timely manner. I was also very satisfied with the quality and workmanship of the carpentry and electrical work planning etc. I've previously worked with contractors and know how frustrating it can be to deal with how stubborn and pushy they can be and I did not experience that with Voila. I appreciated that every part of the journey involved respectful understanding of the requirements and suggestion of alternative solutions when there were challenges. Budget-wise, we were able to work within the budget that was given so this was definitely a huge plus!

text: After spending countless hours talking to 8 different ID firms, we finally decided to entrust Voila with the renovation of our first home. The discussion with Eileen was bi-directional. text: While searching for a design firm, we engage Viola Designers upon seeing their portfolio on Instagram. Upon contact, they were prompt in response and assigned Anvin to us. As with all projects, minor arguments and misunderstandings will bound to happen however I am happy that both parties (We and Anvin) resolved the matter amicably and quickly. Thank you Anvin for planning our place and upholding your responsibly and promise for quality and time. We love our place! Till next time. Keep up the great work!
